source_findings.finding: Agent Builder frames agent infrastructure around building, scaling, and governing multi-agent experiences.

source_findings.finding: NIM presents deployable microservice boundaries for secure model and inference operations.

source_findings.finding: NIM LLM packaging distinguishes production-ready model service boundaries, compatibility, refresh cadence, and security updates.

source_findings.finding: MCP security guidance centers least privilege, confused-deputy avoidance, and careful authorization boundaries.

source_findings.finding: Security logging should provide useful event evidence without leaking sensitive data.

x2_build_implications: Build a v7 x2 helper-runner dashboard around watcher trust, direct-app fallback, CLI long-form reliability, and classifier expansion.
Create a command-surface compatibility queue for Codex app-server, remote-control, sandbox, plugin JSON, CLI bridge, and app watcher surfaces.
Create a no-babysitting enforcement checklist for all future x1 and x2 wait windows.
Promote helper responsibilities into one-helper-one-responsibility acceptance checks.
